column2: (1)  The  Authority  may  in  writing  and  subject  to

column1: such conditions as may be specified therein, delegate to the
CEO and any Head of the relevant division of the Authority
any of its powers or functions and any such person or any
Head of the relevant division shall exercise or perform such
powers  or  functions  in  the  name  and  on  behalf,  of  the
Authority.

column2: (2) The Authority may, notwithstanding any delegation

column1: made under subsection (1), by itself exercise or perform any
power or function so delegated and may at any time revoke
any such delegation.

column2: (1) The Minister may from time to time, issue to the

column1: Authority such general or special directions in writing as to
the exercise and performance of its powers and functions so
as to ensure the giving proper effect to Government Policy
and  it  shall  be  the  duty  of  the  Authority  to  give  effect  to
such directions.

column2: (2) The Minister may direct the Authority to furnish to

column1: him in such form as he may require, returns, accounts and
any other information relating to the work of the Authority,
and  it  shall  be  the  duty  of  the  Authority  to  give  effect  to
such directions.

column2: The  CEO  and  the  officers  and  employees  of  the

column1: Authority shall be deemed to be public officers within the
meaning of and for the purposes of the Penal Code .

column2: The Authority shall be deemed to be a Scheduled

column1: Institution within the meaning and for the purposes of the
Bribery Act and the provisions of that Act shall be construed
accordingly.

column2: (1) Any expenses incurred by the Authority in any

column1: suit or prosecution brought by or against it before any Court,
shall be paid out of the Fund of the Authority and any costs
paid  to  or  recovered  by  the  Authority  in  any  such  suit  or
prosecution shall be credited to the Fund of the Authority.
